Filled Pastry Shells
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 12:27am

Ingredients




1 cup flour
1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese
1 stick butter
2 cans potted meat (deviled ham is best)
1 hard boiled egg, chopped (optional)
1 teaspoon mustard
2 tablespoons pickle relish
1 rib celery, finely chopped
2 tablespoons ketchup

Preparation

1 Mix to make a stiff dough. Chill one hour. Using mini muffin cups, put a small ball of dough in each cup and press up sides and across bottom to cover. Bake at 375 degrees until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. May be frozen until ready for use. Makes 3 dozen. Let stand at room temperature 1 hour before filling.
